Name: A Weird Dog
Author: stylbash
Description:
After making a [s]possum[/s] weird cat, I felt it was only right that I make a weird dog. And what are ponies but very large, weird dogs? 

There's a seasonal file that lets your pony get properly fuzzy in the fall and winter, and a non seasonal option in case you want a fuzzy dog all year round, or if you prefer to keep that winter coat away! Both require Content Patcher and SMAPI.

Mods shown in my screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1573]A Toned Down Stardew Valley[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2777](CP) Pethouse Re-skin to match Yellog's Buildings[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2626]Yellog's Wood Buildings (CP)[/url]﻿ with some edits for personal use.

[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1912]Blossom Trees[/url]
